Thanks for taking time to interview Alex Rivera this morning (IC PM). I pulled the draft scorecard into the attached spreadsheet and left a short evidence checklist in the Drive link below. Two asks: 

1) Please add your numeric scores (technical, product, PM judgment, overall) in the Rivera_scorecard.xlsx and paste one short bullet of evidence (1–2 lines) in column "Notes".
